scenes.text: Welcome to Guess The Frame! To host a game with your friends, click Create Room.
Type in your player name, pick your favorite animated avatar, and hit Enter to join your lobby.
Now choose your match rounds. Then, click Copy Invite Link or share your room code so your crew can jump into the lobby.
Once everyone is in, click Start Game. You'll have ten seconds to review the quick rules, or the host can launch round one immediately.
Round one is live! Look at the screenshot and type your movie guesses into the live chat. First correct answer gets 10 points, second gets 7, and third gets 5 points!
Stuck on a tricky frame? Tap the Hint button to reveal missing letter blanks and solve the movie title.
As the host, you're in full control. You can pause the round timer, skip an impossible frame, or end the game early at any time.
When time runs out, the movie and trivia are revealed. The host simply clicks Next Round to keep the competition rolling.
After the final round, the player with the most points is crowned champion on the victory podium! Rematch your friends and play again.
